title: Teachers Received a Random Genius List, Yet Young Kids Jumped Fifteen IQ Points
description:
You think adult expectations stay locked inside private thoughts! Yet silent beliefs reshape how young minds grow! This is the true story of Robert Rosenthal's Pygmalion Experiment. Here is what went wrong in tracked public schools.
